Aniruddha
--Tattvamañjarī or Bhagavattattvamañjarī. L. 2700. Criticises adv. an. adopts the viś. adv. view.

Aniruddha
a Cāmpāhaṭṭīya (section of the Vārendras) of Bengal; dharmādhikaraṇika of Ballālasena, whom he assisted in the compilation of the Dānasāgara, A. D. 1169; his native place was Vihārapāṭaka on the Ganges; q. Bhojadeva, Govindarāja an. the Kāmadhenu.
--Pitṛdayitā or Karmopadeśinī, for the Sāmavedins. Pt.. Saṁs. Sāh. Pariṣat, no. 6, Calcutta.
--Hāralatā, on śuddhi. Bib. Ind. 1909.
A Cāturmāsyapaddhati by Aniruddha is mentioned in Proceed. ASB. 1869. 137. [Page198-b]

Aniruddha
--Mataṅgavyākhyā (Śaivāgama). Q. by Abhinavagupta in Tantrāloka, Kas. Texts 29 (Vol. VI). p.. 209-10. Kas. Texts 47 (Vol. VIII). p. 178.

Aniruddha
